_about: What Runa should learn from history_chat.txt, with every message about each rule. Used to score the rule learner: a proposed rule is matched to the planted rule (or one-off trap) whose messages it cites most. Do not show this file to the AI.

rules.rule: A driver works at most 12 hours a day including rest. If an arrival would pass that, a relief driver takes over.
Agus is the relief driver for PT Sinar Baja and waits at the Cikampek pool; he meets the truck at a toll rest area.
DOCK-01 has no roof. In heavy rain, cartons are unloaded at DOCK-02.
On Fridays 11:30-13:00 (Friday prayers) only one crew member is on the dock; trucks that arrive then wait until 13:00.
With only one forklift working, unloading takes twice as long (240 cartons: 2 hours instead of 1); space trucks 2 hours apart.
Night overtime unloading needs at least 3 crew, and overtime is at most 3 hours.
When instant noodle (FG-4471) stock covers less than 1 day, a noodle delivery must be received the same day, even at night.
The Cikampek toll road is jammed on Friday afternoons and in heavy rain: about 2 hours extra.
Rudi (CV Mitra Kemasan) may not drive after 20:00. A delivery that would arrive later moves to the next morning.
A truck arriving after the dock closes (22:00) parks in the holding area and is unloaded from 06:00.

one_offs_not_rules.what: Car-free day closed the Jababeka road on Sunday 30 Aug.
Budi's truck had a flat tyre once.
Two crew unloaded once on Saturday in an emergency; Sari said explicitly it is not the rule.
A toll accident on 7 Sep caused a jam. One accident is not a pattern.
